The numerical value used as the ID of this I-PDU. This handle Id is used for the APIs
calls Dlt_TxConfirmation, Dlt_TriggerTransmit, Dlt_TriggerIPDUSend or Dlt_Trigger
IPDUSendWithMetaData, Dlt_CopyTxData and Dlt_TpTxConfirmation to transmit
respectively confirm transmissions of I-PDUs.
